<translate>
<!--T:3-->
'''Demon villages''' are the settlements of the Third Demon World in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]: a plaza surrounded by 3–5 adobe houses, 1–2 farms, adobe-brick paths and lantern posts. Their villagers sell Medi-Bugs, a Time Patroller sells maps to the Demon Realm's world bosses, and Gomah's soldiers keep raiding them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:4-->
</translate>
<translate>
=== Demon Realm Villagers === <!--T:5-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Each house holds 1–2 [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm Villager|Demon Realm Villagers]]. '''40%''' of them are '''bug traders''' who sell 2–3 of these offers:
</translate>

{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:7--> Offer</translate> !! <translate><!--T:8--> Price</translate> !! <translate><!--T:9--> Uses</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:10--> Medi-Bug (Ant)</translate> || <translate><!--T:11--> 8 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|-
| <translate><!--T:12--> Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)</translate> || <translate><!--T:13--> 16 Emeralds</translate> || 2
|-
| <translate><!--T:14--> Medi-Bug (Rhino)</translate> || <translate><!--T:15--> 6 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|-
| <translate><!--T:16--> Medi-Bug (Worm)</translate> || <translate><!--T:17--> 6 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|}

<translate>
<!--T:18-->
See [[Special:MyLanguage/Medi-Bugs|Medi-Bugs]] for what each one does. The other villagers don't trade.
</translate>

<translate>
=== Time Patroller === <!--T:19-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:20-->
One [[Special:MyLanguage/Time Patroller|Time Patroller]] stands on the plaza of every village. He sells maps to the world boss lairs:
</translate>

{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:21--> Map</translate> !! <translate><!--T:22--> Leads to</translate> !! <translate><!--T:23--> Price</translate> !! <translate><!--T:24--> Uses</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:25--> Tamagami Number Three Map</translate> || {{L|Tamagami Number 3}} || <translate><!--T:26--> 12 Emeralds</translate> || 4
|-
| <translate><!--T:27--> Tamagami Number Two Map</translate> || {{L|Tamagami Number 2}} || <translate><!--T:28--> 16 Emeralds</translate> || 4
|-
| <translate><!--T:29--> Tamagami Number One Map</translate> || {{L|Tamagami Number 1}} || <translate><!--T:30--> 20 Emeralds</translate> || 4
|-
| <translate><!--T:31--> Gomah's Horn Cradle Map</translate> || {{L|Gomah's Horn Cradle}} || <translate><!--T:32--> 24 Emeralds</translate> || 4
|}

<translate>
<!--T:33-->
A map stays out of stock until that boss's lair has been found; the lairs are searched for while players are in the Demon Realm.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:34-->
Every resident restocks once per in-game day when you trade with them. Killing a Demon Realm Villager or the Time Patroller '''lowers your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]]'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gomah's patrols == <!--T:35-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:36-->
While players are within 6 chunks of a demon village, [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah Soldier|Gomah Soldiers]] show up on its outskirts in waves of 1–3 (a 30% chance every 20 seconds, up to 4 soldiers per village). Some are bigger or smaller than usual, with stats scaled to match. They attack players, not the villagers.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding one == <!--T:37-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:38-->
Demon villages only generate on the Third Demon World, the top floor where the [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] drops you. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate demon_village}} in the Demon Realm.
</translate>
